176-4875-5147.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7422-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7422-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-574-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5434-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1661-5078-5223-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

301-6258-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-5223-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

413-1580-4871-6248.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3151-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Elves.

206-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

240-1849-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-4359.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

2921-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-647-677-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-647-677-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

625-1978-3717.description:
Cause Viridian Joiner to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat from step 2.

338-671-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-671-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2122-4050-5902.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-5902.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-3967.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-3967.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2909-4280-5195.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist, Veyran and Birgi trigger twice each.
Resolve both Birgi triggers, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping the targeted permanent and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2073-4050-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control a noncreature artifact with mana value equal to one.
2073-4050-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing any noncreature artifact with mana value one to become a 1/1 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact, adding {1}.
The artifact dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2615-4527-4673.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Tree of Perdition has exactly thirteen toughness.
2615-4527-4673.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Cast Lightning Bolt by paying {R}, dealing 3 damage to the opponent.
Cast Hidetsugu's Second Rite by paying {3}{R}, dealing 10 damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

326-889.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-2850-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Repeat.

2334-2493-4872.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
